mapper.select: select t1.reprinamt from (select max(t.dealdate) maxdealdate from interf_ods_account_cash t where t.account=#{account} and t.netno=#{netno} and t.ccy=#{ccy}) v1 left join interf_ods_account_cash t1 on v1.maxdealdate=t1.dealdate and t1.account=#{account} and t1.netno=#{netno} and t1.ccy=#{ccy}
